note: Election of county councillors for the County of Londonderry, polled Thursday 31 October 1946, the county polling alone about four weeks after the rest of Northern Ireland (Derry Journal, 1 November 1946: polling 'yesterday'). Nominations were received on 17 October: 23 nominations for 19 seats, with contests in Faughanvale (three candidates), Dungiven and Maghera. The Returning Officer's notice of 18 October, printed in the Derry Journal of 21 October, records the withdrawal of Francis M'Elroy in Dungiven and of Samuel H. B. Allison Barr and Daniel Henry in Faughanvale, leaving one candidate in each of eighteen divisions and no poll there. Maghera alone was contested, the retiring Unionist Robert Crawford being defeated by the Anti-Partition nominee William Noone. The official notice prints no party labels. Returned unopposed.
